name: Six Senses La Sagesse
positioning: Beach resort of pool suites and villas around a natural saltwater lagoon on Grenada's southeastern coast, between sea cliffs and a secluded sandy bay
best_for: Couples wanting a beachfront suite with its own pool
Families and groups wanting multi-bedroom villas with kitchens and kids' programs

facts.text: The resort is on the southeastern coast of Grenada.
The resort is set across 38 acres of lush tropical landscape.
The resort is centered around a natural saltwater lagoon.
Pool suites and villas are influenced by traditional Caribbean architecture, with natural materials and ocean or garden views.
The spa is styled like a fishing village and overlooks the lagoon.
Wellness facilities include a gym, a yoga room and a biohacking recovery lounge.
An Experience Center serves as a community hub with things to see, make and do.
Callaloo is an all-day cafe and Seafire is a sea-front restaurant centered around a fire pit.
Families have the Grow With Six Senses program and a Teens' Lounge.
The resort is about a 35-minute drive from Grenada's international airport.

highlights.text: In the thatched beachfront suites, each room offers direct access to a private pool and the ocean shore.
The villas, of up to four and five bedrooms, have cliffside views, living rooms, full kitchens, lap pools and private gardens.
The spa is designed like a village of thatched cottages connected by walkways and separated by water.
Guests can tour local farms, including a women's farming cooperative.

considerations.text: The resort is set away from St. George's, Grand Anse beach and the rainforest treks, each about 30 minutes by car.
WhataHotel notes limited nearby dining and entertainment options.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: Six Senses La Sagesse, Grenada
